|translation='''Title:''' This Is Just Wrong.

'''Card text:'''
Deploy on any male character. Target one female character in play. The target is power −2. Cancel the Utinni Effect when it is at the same place as the target.

'''Lore:'''
“How could you think that? You apparently don’t know much about women.”

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese uses the wording 同じ場所 (same place).
